title: Size of the tabulated circuit
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w,n$ be natural numbers, let $F$ assign a Boolean list to each instruction kind and Boolean list, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For every program $P$ consisting of instructions with kinds in $\kappa$ and every $o,j\in\mathbb{N}$, the size of the associated tabulated circuit is $n+2+|z|+W(|P|+1)$, where $W$ is the tabulation width determined by $m,w,F$, and $|z|$ and $|P|$ denote list lengths.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a list of instructions with kinds in $\kappa$
